Authored the five A page items and three B page examples. The proofs cover bialgebra tensor coherence, finite module duals, the antipode twist on biduals, and the three worked examples. I also added the missing Hopf definition dependency to the left-dual definition.

The relevant supplier items in batches 2–4 have since appeared. I inspected their current bodies and recorded the matching interfaces and exact excerpts in the batch evidence. The whole prerequisite pages remain drafts and open for reconciliation.

All eight Step 1 records remain **escalated**. They were recorded before those suppliers appeared, and I left them untouched as instructed. One record also predates the new Hopf definition dependency and needs owner reconciliation.

**Checks:** precheck passed for 6 proof-bearing items; proof layout passed for 8 items and 38 steps; strict proof contracts passed with 0 errors; all 8 item dependency levels match; coverage, content policy, focused dependency, and render checks passed. The run-wide batch dependency check is still blocked by unescaped `\llbracket` in three unrelated batch-11 item frontmatters. I did not edit those files or write a shared run-level artifact.

The batch notes summarize source dispositions, supplier checks, escalations, and blockers: [batch 5 notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/hopf-hecke-unfinished-15-2026-10-15-batch-5.notes.md).
